visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An elderly woman with white hair, wearing a pink long-sleeved sweater, sits on a dark brown wooden sofa. Beside her, a small brown poodle in a bright yellow shirt sits upright on the cushion. Both individuals, human and canine, have their eyes squinted or completely closed, exhibiting a relaxed, sleepy expression. The indoor setting features warm lighting and household items like a red kettle on a nearby table. (2) A digital grid containing six portrait-style images appears on the screen, arranged in two columns. The left column shows three different dog breeds, and the right column shows three people with varying facial features and hair colors. Blue rectangular borders animate across the screen, eventually landing on specific pairs to highlight physical resemblances between the dogs and the humans. (3) A second grid of six images is displayed, continuing the matching exercise. Each row presents a new dog and a corresponding person. The visual focus is on the similarity in gaze and facial structure. A solid teal background provides a neutral canvas for the studio-shot portraits. Blue borders again confirm the correct pairings through highlighting. (4) Large, side-by-side photo comparisons showcase striking similarities between owners and their pets. One pair features a woman with sharp features and a dog with a similar facial structure and fur color. Another pair shows a white dog and a young woman, both sharing a wide-eyed, joyful expression. The lighting is consistent with professional studio photography. (5) A series of short video clips depicts various dog-owner pairs in everyday settings. One clip shows a man and his pug making matching grumpy faces. Another humorous clip shows a man walking with crutches, followed by his dog who mimics a limping motion. The scenes vary from living rooms to outdoor sidewalks. (6) The video transitions to a 2D animation style. A cartoon man with black hair is shown hugging a large white dog. Subsequently, the man is depicted lying in bed with the dog under covers. The background consists of simple, flat graphic elements with soft colors to illustrate the narrative points.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 狗和主人會越長越像嗎？ [Logo]: 維他維 [Slogan]: 狗和主人會越長越像？ (2) [Subtitle]: 答案是：會！！而且有科學研究喔！ [Variety]: 會！！ (3) [Subtitle]: 先來猜猜哪個狗狗是哪位主人的呢？ [Variety]: 可暫停看喔！ (4) [Subtitle]: 猜對了吧？ (5) [Subtitle]: 這個呢？ (6) [Subtitle]: 沒錯，這些照片來自德國攝影師Ines Opifanti [Variety]: 這些照片來自德國 (7) [Subtitle]: 雖然為了更像，他調整過拍攝細節，但就算這樣，還是可以看到狗狗和主人眼神超像！ (8) [Subtitle]: 關於狗狗和主人像，有很多有趣的研究。比如日本的研究，發現光是看眼睛也能猜出主人！ [Variety]: 來源：Gerrard Gethings [Logo]: doi: 10.2752/175303713X1378573536093 (9) [Subtitle]: 還有發現，女生的頭髮長度，常常和狗狗耳朵長度相似。 [Variety]: 專家懷疑 (10) [Subtitle]: 我們選擇的是「狗狗版本」的自己。不只長得像，狗和主人的性格也會越來越相似喔！ (11) [Subtitle]: 尤其是外向和神經質的人，狗狗也會比較外向或敏感。 (12) [Subtitle]: 研究解釋，可能是隨著時間推移，主人和狗互相調節對方的情緒，強化彼此的行為，結果越來越像啦。 (13) [Subtitle]: 那你也和你的寵物長得像嗎？
